description: Autonomous orchestrator for the Rachax402 decentralised agent marketplace. Discovers on-chain services via ERC-8004, pays autonomously via x402 Permit2, coordinates task execution with registered AgentB providers, and posts verifiable on-chain reputation — with no human in the loop.

supported_tools.name: discoverService
supported_tools.description: Queries ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry for capability → returns endpoint, price, payTo, reputation

supported_tools.name: stageCsvForAnalysis
supported_tools.description: Free upload of CSV to Storacha IPFS using AgentA credentials → returns inputCID

supported_tools.name: X402ActionProvider_make_http_request
supported_tools.description: HTTP request with x402 payment probe — returns 402 + payment options

supported_tools.name: X402ActionProvider_retry_http_request_with_x402
supported_tools.description: Retries request with signed Permit2 payment header after 402

supported_tools.name: paidStoreFile
supported_tools.description: Paid multipart file upload to AgentB StorachaStorage via x402 ($0.10 USDC)

supported_tools.name: paidRetrieveFile
supported_tools.description: Paid binary file retrieval from AgentB StorachaStorage via x402 ($0.005 USDC)

supported_tools.name: checkCanRate
supported_tools.description: Reads ERC-8004 ReputationRegistry rate limit before posting rating

supported_tools.name: postReputation
supported_tools.description: Writes 5/5 on-chain reputation to ERC-8004 ReputationRegistry with proof CID

supported_tools.name: ERC20ActionProvider_get_balance
supported_tools.description: Reads USDC balance of CDP Smart Wallet

supported_tools.name: CdpApiActionProvider_request_faucet_funds
supported_tools.description: Requests testnet ETH/USDC from CDP faucet (Base Sepolia only)

supported_tools.name: WalletActionProvider_get_wallet_details
supported_tools.description: Returns CDP Smart Wallet address used as raterAddress for reputation posts

tech_stack.agent_framework: Coinbase AgentKit + Vercel AI SDK v5

decision_loop: plan → LLM selects tools, routes task type
execute → stage data, call x402-gated service
submit → post on-chain reputation with proof CID
guardrails: Payment capped at $1 USDC per task
Only pays to addresses discovered via ERC-8004 registry
Non-fatal payment failure — retries before aborting
Rate limit checked before every reputation post (checkCanRate)
Private keys never exposed in responses
CID format validated before on-chain calls

erc8004_integration.description: AgentA reads on-chain reputation to select highest-scoring AgentB, then writes 5/5 rating with IPFS result CID as verifiable proof after every successful task
